about_the_game:
This pack can be used to create backgrounds for projects themed around Japanese schools.
Since it includes both indoor and outdoor school settings, you can depict a wide variety of situations.

By combining this pack with the “SERIALGAMES Living Good City Tileset” or other tilesets from the “Living Good City Tileset” series, you can further expand the world of your game.

As a bonus, this pack also includes four character graphics, featuring both male and female students. After building your school background with the tilesets, you can add these walking characters to immediately bring the school world to life.

Included Assets

  • Tilesets (B, A2, A4 [indoor], A4 [outdoor], A5 [indoor], A5 [outdoor], C)
    A total of 21 sheets, with day, evening, and night variations.

  • Tile A4: Ground patterns (grass, soil, etc.)

  • Tile A4 (indoor): 8 types of interior school wall patterns

  • Tile A4 (outdoor): 12 types of exterior school wall patterns

  • Tile A5 (indoor): Indoor stairs, floor patterns, gymnasium floor lines, etc.

  • Tile A5 (outdoor): Outdoor stairs, floor patterns, field lines, baseball field lines, etc.

  • Tile B:

    • Indoor school items (doors, windows, blackboards, lockers, desks, chairs, curtains, toilets, etc.)

    • Music room items (piano, drum set, portraits, music stands, etc.)

    • Art room items (easels, plaster busts, canvas shelves, etc.)

    • Gymnasium items (stage curtains, vaulting boxes, ping-pong tables, basketball hoops, etc.)

    • Infirmary items (beds, curtains, scales, medicine shelf, etc.)

    • Staff room items (desks, bookshelves, etc.)

    • Outdoor items (school gate, doors, drinking fountains, trees, flowerbeds, flowers, etc.)

    • Playground items (goalposts, scoreboards, hurdles, benches, fences, etc.)

  • Tile C: Old school building items (roofs, doors, etc.)

  • Walking Characters (4-directional): 4 types

    • Male student

    • Female student

    • Human anatomy model

    • Skeleton model

---------------

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
